SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.`arg_result`, ''), '未登记') AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_escalation_project` p WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.`arg_result`, ''), '未登记') ORDER BY `count` DESC
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.`declare_dept`, ''), '未填写') AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_escalation_project` p WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.`declare_dept`, ''), '未填写') ORDER BY `count` DESC
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.`xzqh`, ''), '未填写') AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_escalation_project` p WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.`xzqh`, ''), '未填写') ORDER BY `count` DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(p.`declare_date`, '%Y-%m') AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_escalation_project` p WHERE p.`declare_date` IS NOT NULL AND GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(p.`declare_date`, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY `name`
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.`project_type`, ''), '未填写') AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_escalation_project` p WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.`project_type`, ''), '未填写') ORDER BY `count` DESC
SELECT p.`status` AS `status`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_escalation_project` p WHERE GROUP BY p.`status` ORDER BY `count` DESC
